posts.cooked:
Relative newbie to the forums, so thought I'd ask a question I've always wondered: What's the history behind the various name badges people have?

 

Some of them are pretty clear (admin, mod, playtester), but I'm curious behind the story behind Foote getting 'Harmony' or some of the various other badges that I see from time to time.
